content: State-of-the-Art Representation Models. The absolute scores of CC+Wiki ft, Wiki ft, and m-bert are not directly comparable, because these models have different coverage. In particular, Multi-SimLex contains some out-of-vocabulary (OOV) words whose static ft embeddings are not available. On the other hand, m-bert has perfect coverage. A general comparison between CC+Wiki and Wiki ft vectors, however, supports the intuition that larger corpora (such as CC+Wiki) yield higher correlations. Another finding is that a single massively multilingual model such as m-bert cannot produce semantically rich word-level representations. Whether this actually happens because the training objective is different—or because the need to represent 100+ languages reduces its language-specific capacity—is investigated further below.
